The word सह 'together' is compounded with a word ending with the third case-affix and the compound is बहुव्रीही ; provided that, the companion and the person accompanied are equally effected by any action or thing, in the same manner.

Terms: समास-बहुव्रीही-विभक्ति
The affix अण् already ordained -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण्

, comes after the name of a colour in the sense of 'coloured thereby'.

Terms: अण्

After a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction an affix is added in the sense of 'completed by him' when the whole word so formed is the name of a country.

Terms: चातुर्थिक-अञ्

The affix ठञ् comes after a word denoting time in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'to be accomplished by that time'.

Terms: ठञ्
After a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction, an affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण्

etc., comes in the sense of 'enounced by him'.

Terms: विभक्ति-3

etc. comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'in the same direction with that'.

Terms: विभक्ति-3

The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'he plays', 'he digs', 'he conquers' or 'he is conquered'.

Terms: ठक्

-36 have the sense of 'purchased with this price' and are added to a word in the third case in construction.

Terms:

The affix ठञ् comes after a word denoting time in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense 'to be subdued, to be gained or attained, to be completed and to be easily completed in that time'.

Terms: ठञ्

The affixes ण and यत् come respectively after the words यथा-कथा-च and हस्त being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction having the sense of what is 'given or is done in this way'.

Terms: ण and यत्

The affix वति (वत्) comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction, in the sense of 'like that' when the meaning is 'similarity of action'.

Terms: वति

The affixes चुञ्चुप् (चुञ्चु) and चणप् (चण) come in the sense of 'celebrated through this' after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: चुञ्चुप् (चुञ्चु) and चणप् (चण)
